index_record.dataset_generation_caption:
The figure illustrates the end-to-end workflow of the LookDeep Health AI-driven patient monitoring platform, structured as a horizontal pipeline with a top visual narrative and a bottom abstracted computational flow. The global layout is divided into two main regions: an upper illustrative scene depicting a hospital environment and a lower schematic representation labeled 'Computer Vision Pipeline' that details the processing stages. The upper region shows a patient lying in a hospital bed, connected to an IV drip, with a camera mounted on the wall capturing the scene. Dashed lines indicate the field of view of the camera, which focuses on the patient and surrounding area. To the right, a large monitor displays a live feed of the patient, along with multiple data panels showing graphs, bar charts, and user profiles, symbolizing real-time analytics. A doctor stands beside the monitor, observing the data, indicating the system’s output is intended for clinical decision support.

The lower section presents the core computer vision pipeline as a sequence of five processing modules connected by solid rightward arrows, starting from an oval labeled 'Image' and ending at an oval labeled 'Output'. The modules are rectangular boxes with black borders and white backgrounds, containing black text. The first module is 'Object Detector', followed by 'Role Classifier', then 'Motion Estimation', and finally 'Logical Prediction'. These modules represent successive stages of analysis: detecting objects in the image, classifying roles (e.g., patient, nurse), estimating motion patterns, and making logical inferences based on the combined data. A dashed line with a downward arrow connects the camera in the upper scene to the 'Image' input of the pipeline, visually linking the physical data capture to the computational process. Another dashed line with an upward arrow connects the 'Output' of the pipeline to the monitor in the upper scene, indicating that the processed results are displayed for human review. The entire pipeline is enclosed within a light gray rectangular background, with the title 'Computer Vision Pipeline' written in bold above it, spanning the width of the modules. The color scheme is predominantly purple and lavender, with clean, minimalistic line art, emphasizing clarity and modernity. The figure effectively conveys how raw visual data from a hospital room is transformed into actionable insights through a multi-stage AI pipeline, ultimately supporting healthcare professionals in monitoring patients.
